# /crav1-explain

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From the system notes](../../from-explain.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-explain/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Read the system notes spark, ideas, intake, match, or repos-to-spec already wrote (docs/system/).

## Runs when

System notes already exist. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: `docs/system/` notes and the feature index.

Reads the `docs/system/` notes spark, ideas, intake, or match already wrote, and on every run the feature index against each slice’s node in `docs/system/diagrams.md` and its line in `## How the parts connect`.

## Writes

In short: Nothing (a short TLDR in chat).

Writes a short TLDR in the chat, one level deeper only when asked, one part when pointed at, and, when the picture has nothing on the question, the first paragraph of the matching spec labelled as coming from the spec. Shows a stale research note as stale.

## Does not

Leaves specs, code, and the picture alone.

Limits and exceptions: does not guess, invent a second document, teach, or start Specify, Plan, or Build. Names match only by slug, spec title, or main resource name. At the end it lists each slice missing entirely or partly, including done and retired, with status, and names [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md) without running it. When no spec matches either, it says so and names [`/crav1-whats-known-about`](crav1-whats-known-about.md) without running it. It does not clear a stale research mark.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-whats-known-about`](crav1-whats-known-about.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Keep the picture current. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.8.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).
